title: 雲海のお裾分けと、迷子の銀色さん
author: 白湯 ぬくみ

en.title: A Gift from the Sea of Clouds and the Lost Silver
en.premise: Sora is a chef who travels the skies aboard an aging cafe ship, offering warm meals and a place of respite to all who visit. His quiet life changes when he discovers "Gin-iro," a small, drifting AI who has lost both its memories and its purpose. This is a story of an AI with no place to call home, searching for its own proof of existence through the "inefficient warmth" of seasonal stews and hand-knitted scarves.

zh.title: 云海的馈赠与迷路的银色
zh.premise: 旅居天空的料理人索拉，在破旧的咖啡船上，为每一位访客提供温暖的餐点与休憩之所。直到有一天，他遇见了漂浮在云海之中、失去了记忆与目标的微小人工智能——“银色”。这是一个失去归宿的AI，在触碰到季节炖菜、手工围巾这些“与效率无关的温暖”时，逐渐寻找属于自己生存证明的故事。
